summary.headline: Ephemeris Tables and Notation
summary.text: Explanation of ephemeris tables for the Sun, Moon, and five planets, including their zodiacal positions at midday and the notation of signs, degrees, and minutes. It describes carrying values when degrees or minutes reach their limits and omitting repeated digits in consecutive daily entries.
